entities.name: Freestriders
entities.description: Gang of nomadic outlaw vigilantes on Thunder Junction who help the disenfranchised and patrol near the Omenpaths.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: Scorpion dragon of the Hellspurs who hunted down the Freestriders.

entities.name: Annie Flash
entities.description: Freestrider who took her nephew Tommy into her care and quit the gang.

entities.name: Tommy
entities.description: Annie Flash's nephew, nearly killed by Akul's venom.

entities.name: Omenpaths
entities.description: Passages the Freestriders patrol to protect new arrivals.

events.summary: The Freestriders rob Akul and the Hellspurs.
events.quote: After the Freestriders robbed Akul and the Hellspurs

events.summary: Akul attacks the Freestriders despite their returning what they stole, nearly killing Tommy with venom.
events.quote: Akul attacked them regardless, almost killing Annie Flash 's nephew Tommy with his venom

events.summary: Annie Flash takes Tommy into her care and quits the gang.
events.quote: she took Tommy into her care and quit the gang

relations.note: Akul hunted them after the robbery.
relations.quote: the scorpion dragon spent weeks tracking them down and killing those that got in his way
